decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera close to the core business and already given a dedicated webpage, it is likely to be retained while management uses organisational slack and long space-market sales cycles to judge it against aspirations.
Its modular navigation focus fits the firm's strategic direction toward flexible sensors, so a large R&D-intensive firm in a growing industry would be unlikely to drop it after only one year.

Although somewhat more exploratory than the camera lines, it still builds on established capabilities and the firm has enough technical depth and slack to continue learning before concluding it falls short of aspirations.

The LiDAR sensor appears less strongly commercialised so far because it was only mentioned on the website, but its closeness to the firm's competencies and the long qualification horizon in space markets still make near-term withdrawal less likely than retention.
